meta.name: epic-breakdown-advisor
meta.description: Break down epics into user stories with Humanizing Work split patterns. Use when a backlog item is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型史诗拆解为可估算的用户故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果待办项太大难以估算或安全交付
copy.tagline_en: Break down large epics into estimable user stories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if backlog items are too large to estimate or deliver safely

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你一步步把大型需求（epic）拆成更小的用户故事。它会先检查你的需求是否合格，然后按顺序尝试9种拆分模式，帮你找到最合适的拆分方式，确保每个小故事都能独立交付用户价值。
howto.when: 当你有一个需求太大，无法估算、排期或安全交付时，就可以使用这个技能。通常在梳理产品待办列表或冲刺规划前触发。

say.text: 帮我拆分这个史诗：作为管理员，我可以导出任何报告。
say.note: 技能会引导你完成拆分流程。

say.text: 这个大型功能应该用哪种故事拆分模式？
say.note: 技能会按顺序检查9种模式。

say.text: 把这个用户注册流程拆成小故事。
say.note: 技能会应用工作流步骤模式。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you step by step to break down large epics into smaller user stories. It first validates your story, then sequentially applies 9 splitting patterns to find the best fit, ensuring each story delivers end-to-end user value.
howto.when_en: Use when a backlog item is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely. Typically triggered during backlog refinement or before sprint planning.

say_en.text: Break down this epic: As an admin, I can export any report.
say_en.note: The skill will guide you through the splitting process.

say_en.text: Which story-splitting pattern should I use for this large feature?
say_en.note: The skill checks 9 patterns in order.

say_en.text: Split this user registration workflow into smaller stories.
say_en.note: The skill applies the workflow steps pattern.
